task: Deploy bannon-daemon to Render free tier with keepalive
resume_brief: STANDALONE BRIEF — owner-directed 2026-10-09: Oracle Cloud rejected his card (prepaid/virtual not accepted) — 'need another way that doesn't do this.' Pivot to a NO-CREDIT-CARD path. CONTEXT: bannon-daemon is an Express+WebSocket+Telegram-bot Node backend (real server: godmode/server.ts, has GET /health). It needs always-on; serverless is out. The Oracle SSH deploy (PR #56, deploy.yml + deploy/) must be REPLACED. YOUR JOB: (1) Switch to Render's free tier — verify from Render's current docs that the free tier needs NO credit card (it historically doesn't) and gives 750 instance-hours/month (enough for one service). Deploy via Render's native GitHub integration: add a render.yaml blueprint (node runtime, buildCommand 'npm run build' in godmode/, startCommand 'npm start', healthCheckPath /health) — or a deploy-hook approach if cleaner. (2) SOLVE THE SLEEP PROBLEM: Render free web services sleep after 15 min idle, which would kill the Telegram bot. Add a .github/workflows/keepalive.yml cron that curls the /health endpoint every 10 minutes (uses only free Actions minutes, no new accounts). (3) Remove/replace the Oracle deploy.yml SSH flow and the deploy/ scripts (or leave them clearly marked superseded — don't leave two live deploy paths; pick one: replace). Keep npm ci + npm run build as the pre-deploy gate. Branch -> PR -> merge per the no-open-PRs law. OWNER-ACTION CHECKLIST in the PR (must be zero-card): almost nothing — Render account via GitHub login (free, no card), create the Web Service from render.yaml, paste the service URL for the keepalive workflow (or make the keepalive read it from a repo variable). RULES: heartbeat THIS checkpoint every 15 min; validate the YAML; no hallucinated Render config keys — check Render's blueprint spec docs. Report: PR link + the exact owner steps.
